title: Pseudo-coherence of affine bounded-above finite-presentation flat complexes
statement: Let S be affine and D a cochain complex of O_S-modules, strictly zero above b∈ℕ and termwise flat over id_S, quasi-coherent and finitely presented. With A=Γ(S,⊤) and the standard derived category of A-modules, Q of the termwise global-section complex of D is pseudo-coherent in the ring sense (has a bounded-above finite-free representative). No residue vanishing or lower degree bound is assumed.

source.place: Tag 064U, implication (3) to (1); affine identification as in 08EB

proof.text: Set A = Gamma(S, top) and P = evaluation at top applied termwise to D. The map_isStrictlySupported instance preserves the bound b. For each term, finitePresentation_sections_of_isFinitePresentation gives finite presentation of its sections directly. Evaluate IsFlatOver(id_S) at the top affine open twice and simplify id_S.appLE to the identity; Module.compHom along this identity is the usual action. Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation gives projectivity, and finite presentation gives finiteness. No affine tilde equivalence is needed.

Apply the proved finite-projective-complex-free-model theorem to P at b. It gives a bounded-above finite-free F and a quasi-isomorphism f:F -> P. isIso_Q_map_iff_quasiIso converts f to an isomorphism Q(F) -> Q(P), and these witnesses directly establish the existing definition IsPseudoCoherent.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_finitePresentation_flat_pseudoCoherent (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : IsAffine S) (D : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ) (b : ℕ)
    (hDle : D.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hDflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S))
    (hDqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hDfp : ∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFinitePresentation) :
      (letI : CommRing (S.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤)) :=
        inferInstanceAs (CommRing Γ(S, ⊤));
        letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (S.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤)));
        DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} S.ringCatSheaf (.op ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D)))
